name: aicp
description: AICP - Academia-Industry Collaboration Portal with Local MERN + Own AI/ML System

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "cd server && npm run dev" "cd ai-service && py app.py"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ../ai-service && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.train-ai: cd ai-training && python preprocessing/prepare_data.py && python training/train_skill_classifier.py
scripts.lint: concurrently "npm run lint --prefix client" "npm run lint --prefix server"
